note: What each package channel is meant to be serving right now. Publishing is always a deliberate act (docs/release-checklist.md section 8); nothing in this repository submits a package. scripts/check-feed-drift.ps1 reads this file, reports what the public feeds actually serve, and never publishes anything.

github.note: The GitHub Release is the source every other channel downloads from, so it is the one channel that is never held.

chocolatey.reason: 0.7.0 and 0.8.0 shipped an MSI without the FFmpeg runtime DLLs, and 0.9.0 was tagged before its release gates were met. The next submission is 0.9.1, qualified through the campaign.

winget.reason: Same as Chocolatey: 0.9.0 is not a version to move users onto. The manifests in packaging/winget are kept current so the 0.9.1 submission is a validate-and-submit, not a rewrite.

scoop.reason: The published bucket entry autoupdates from the newest GitHub Release once someone runs scoop update against it, so this hold is a statement about what the bucket has been seen serving rather than something the repository enforces.
